title: Item and Service Master Data Read-First
businessPurpose: Inspect whether Universaarl has realistic item/service master-data context for the next O2C/P2P route decision before any document, draft, preview or posting work starts.

realCustomerDataPolicy.rule: Use realistic Universaarl-style customers, vendors, items and services with business purpose, ownership, dependencies and UAT/training purpose. Do not use real confidential customer data in repo, screenshots or evidence.

decisionQuestions: Which item/service records are already visible in UNIVERSAARL-DE?
Do visible records support realistic O2C/P2P training scenarios or are they only placeholders?
Which item/service fields must be proven before any sales or purchase document is created?
Which setup boundaries remain before item/service data can be used in posting-ready processes?

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: The customer card setup is visible, but O2C must not start from customer data alone. Realistic item/service context is the next read-first dependency before any document or posting gate.
